name: Lightning
description: Fractal discharge pathway optimizing potential difference resolution and atmospheric ion balancing.

core_attributes.pattern: electrical discharge, fractal branching, field equalization

scope.definition: Peak temperature of lightning return stroke channel — fraction of measured peak (30,000 K) relative to solar surface temperature (5778 K) — expressed as multiples of solar surface temperature.

evidence.source: Uman (1987) 'The Lightning Discharge', Academic Press; Rakov & Uman (2003) 'Lightning: Physics and Effects', Cambridge UP.
cross_domain_examples: lightning return stroke: 27,000-30,000 K peak temperature — 5× hotter than Sun's surface at 5778 K
plasma channel reaches 30,000 K in <1 µs, then cools to 3,000 K in 100 µs — rapid thermalization
arc welding plasma: 6,000-20,000 K — same air plasma physics at lower current

scope.falsifiability: If optical spectroscopy of lightning channels consistently measures peak temperatures below 15,000 K, the 5× solar surface temperature claim is overstated.
scope.measurement_limits: Peak temperature exists for <1 µs in the core channel (0.1-1 cm diameter). Channel edge temperature is 3-5× lower. Measurement requires spectroscopic analysis with ns time resolution.
